name: Pomerado
tagline: Connect your agents to any website. The cheaper, faster, and more reliable alternative to browser use.
description: Give your agents tools for the websites you use. Pomerado turns any website into an API or MCP, so it's cheaper, faster and more reliable than driving a browser. Use it whenever a task involves a website or web app, such as looking things up, filling in forms and automating web workflows.
